metadata.name: Northwind Marketplace resolution examples
metadata.description: Synthetic few-shot examples used to draft supervisor resolutions.

entries.issue_name: Tax ID does not match business name during registration
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: tax id does not match business name during registration.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for seller registration: I understand the registration form is rejecting your tax ID. This usually happens when the legal business name differs from the name on the tax certificate. Let's check both together.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to read out the legal business name exactly as printed on the tax certificate.
Compare it with the name entered on the registration form, including punctuation and suffixes such as 'Pvt' or 'LLC'.
If they differ, guide the caller to edit the business name field to match the certificate and resubmit.
If the names already match, ask the caller to clear the browser cache and retry validation once.
If validation still fails, collect a screenshot of the error and escalate.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: verification email link expired.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for seller registration: Verification links stay valid for 24 hours. I'll help you request a fresh link so you can finish activating the account.
resolution_steps: Confirm the email address the caller registered with.
Ask the caller to open the sign-in page and choose 'Resend verification email'.
Advise them to check spam or quarantine folders and to open the newest email only.
If no email arrives within 15 minutes, verify the address for typos in the admin view and correct it.
Escalate if the address is correct and emails are still not delivered.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: registration stuck in pending review.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for seller registration: New seller applications are reviewed within three business days. Let me check where yours is in the queue.
resolution_steps: Note the registration reference number from the caller.
Check how many business days have passed since submission.
If under three business days, explain the review timeline and set expectations.
If the application is flagged for missing documents, tell the caller which documents to upload.
If it is older than three business days with no flags, escalate for manual review.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: login code sms not arriving.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for login & otp: Sorry you're not receiving the login code. Most delays come from network filters or an outdated mobile number, so let's check both.
resolution_steps: Confirm the last four digits of the registered mobile number with the caller.
Ask the caller to wait 60 seconds and use 'Resend OTP' only once to avoid rate limits.
Check whether the number has do-not-disturb or promotional SMS blocking enabled.
Offer the email OTP option if the account has a verified email.
If the registered number is outdated, start the mobile number update process.

entries.issue_name: Account locked after failed login attempts
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: account locked after failed login attempts.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for login & otp: For security, accounts lock for 30 minutes after five failed attempts. I can help you get back in safely.
resolution_steps: Tell the caller how long remains on the 30-minute lock.
Recommend resetting the password instead of guessing again once the lock lifts.
Verify identity using the registered email and the business reference number.
If the caller needs urgent access, raise an unlock request after identity verification.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: password reset link not working.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for login & otp: Password reset links expire after one hour and only the newest link works. Let's send a fresh one.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to request a new reset link from the sign-in page.
Remind them to use only the most recent email, since earlier links are invalidated.
Ask them to open the link in a private browser window to avoid stale sessions.
If the new password is rejected, read out the password rules: 12+ characters with a number and a symbol.
Escalate if the reset page shows an error code.
required_documents: Screenshot of the error, if any

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: update registered business address.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for profile & kyc: You can update the registered address from the profile page; the change goes live after a quick document check.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to open Profile > Business details > Address.
Have them enter the new address and upload a supporting address proof dated within the last three months.
Explain that open orders keep their original delivery address.
Tell the caller the compliance review takes up to two business days.
required_documents: Address proof dated within three months

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: kyc document rejected.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for profile & kyc: I'm sorry your KYC document was rejected. The rejection note usually tells us exactly what to fix.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to read the rejection reason shown under Profile > Verification.
If the image was unclear, ask for a colour scan at 300 dpi or higher.
If the document has expired, ask them to upload a currently valid one.
If the name differs from the profile, align the profile name or upload a name-change document.
Escalate if the caller believes the rejection was made in error.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: change authorised signatory.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for profile & kyc: Changing the authorised signatory needs a board or owner authorisation letter so we can protect your account.
resolution_steps: Confirm the caller is currently an admin on the seller account.
Ask them to upload an authorisation letter naming the new signatory.
Have the new signatory complete identity verification from their own login.
Explain that pending bids remain signed by the previous signatory.
required_documents: Identity proof of the new signatory

entries.issue_name: Payout bank account could not be verified
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: payout bank account could not be verified.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for bank account & payouts: Bank verification fails when the account holder name or routing code doesn't match bank records. Let's check them.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to confirm the account holder name exactly as on the bank statement.
Verify the bank routing code and account number digit by digit.
Ask whether the account is a current account in the business's name; personal accounts are not accepted.
Have the caller re-run verification after correcting the details.
If it fails again, collect a cancelled cheque or bank letter and escalate.
required_documents: Cancelled cheque or bank confirmation letter

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: change payout bank account.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for bank account & payouts: You can change the payout account at any time; payouts pause briefly while the new account is verified.
resolution_steps: Confirm the caller is the account admin.
Ask them to add the new account under Finance > Payout accounts.
Explain that a small test credit will verify the account within one business day.
Tell them to set the new account as primary once verified.
required_documents: Cancelled cheque for the new account

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: payout on hold.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for bank account & payouts: Payouts are held when there's an open dispute, missing KYC, or an unverified bank account. Let me find which applies.
resolution_steps: Check the hold reason shown under Finance > Payouts.
If KYC is incomplete, guide the caller to finish verification.
If a dispute is open, explain that the related amount is released once the dispute closes.
If no reason is shown, escalate with the payout reference.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: listing missing from buyer search.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for catalogue & listings: New listings appear in search after quality review, usually within 24 hours. Let's confirm the listing status.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to open Catalogue > My listings and read the status of the product.
If the status is 'In review', explain the 24-hour review window.
If the status is 'Inactive', ask them to check stock quantity and price validity dates.
If the status is 'Live' but not in search, ask them to search by the exact listing ID.
Escalate with the listing ID if it is live but still not searchable after 24 hours.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: listing rejected in quality check.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for catalogue & listings: Listings are rejected when images, specifications or pricing don't meet catalogue rules. The rejection note lists the reason.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to read the rejection note on the listing.
For image issues, ask for a plain white background and at least 800x800 pixels.
For specification issues, ensure mandatory attributes such as model and warranty are filled.
For pricing issues, confirm the price is within the allowed range for the category.
Ask the caller to edit and resubmit the listing.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: bulk upload template errors.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for catalogue & listings: Bulk upload errors usually come from an outdated template or a few invalid rows. The error report pinpoints them.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to download the latest template from Catalogue > Bulk upload.
Have them open the error report and fix the rows it lists.
Remind them not to rename columns or change the sheet order.
Ask them to upload no more than 500 rows per file.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: brand approval pending.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for brand authorisation: Brand approvals take up to five business days because we verify trademark ownership. Let's check the status.
resolution_steps: Note the brand request ID from the caller.
Check whether the request is waiting on a document from the seller.
If complete and under five business days, explain the timeline.
If over five business days, escalate with the brand request ID.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: reseller authorisation letter rejected.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for brand authorisation: To sell another company's brand, we need a valid authorisation letter from the brand owner. Let's see why it was rejected.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to read the rejection reason.
Confirm the letter is on the brand owner's letterhead and signed.
Check the letter names the seller's legal business name and has a validity date.
Ask the caller to upload the corrected letter.
required_documents: Signed authorisation letter from the brand owner

entries.issue_name: Add a new brand to the catalogue
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: add a new brand to the catalogue.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for brand authorisation: If your brand isn't in the dropdown, you can request it. Once approved, it becomes available for your listings.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to search the brand list once more with alternate spellings.
Guide them to Catalogue > Brands > Request new brand.
Have them attach the trademark certificate or brand ownership proof.
Explain the five-business-day review timeline.
required_documents: Trademark certificate or brand ownership proof

entries.issue_name: Unable to submit bid before deadline
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: unable to submit bid before deadline.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for bids & reverse auctions: Bid submission blocks when a mandatory document or declaration is missing. Let's find what's pending before the deadline.
resolution_steps: Note the bid number and the submission deadline.
Ask the caller to open the bid checklist and read any items marked incomplete.
Confirm all mandatory documents are PDF files under 10 MB each.
Ask them to accept the declarations on the final page.
If the deadline is within one hour and the button is still disabled, escalate immediately.

entries.issue_name: Reverse auction not visible to seller
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: reverse auction not visible to seller.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for bids & reverse auctions: Only sellers who qualified in the technical round are invited to the reverse auction. Let me check your status.
resolution_steps: Note the bid number linked to the auction.
Check whether the seller qualified in the technical evaluation.
If qualified, ask the caller to check Bids > Auctions and refresh after the start time.
If not qualified, explain the evaluation result and where to view remarks.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: bid disqualified in technical evaluation.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for bids & reverse auctions: I'm sorry your bid was disqualified. The evaluation remarks explain why, and you may be able to raise a representation.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to open the bid and read the evaluation remarks.
Explain that representations can be raised within 48 hours of the result.
Guide them to Bids > Representation and attach supporting documents.
Set expectations that the buyer reviews representations, not the support team.

entries.issue_name: Order not appearing in seller dashboard
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: order not appearing in seller dashboard.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for orders & delivery: Orders appear in the dashboard within 15 minutes of the buyer confirming. Let's find yours.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number the buyer shared.
Ask the caller to search by order number under Orders > All orders.
Check that the date filter includes the order date.
If a sub-user is logged in, confirm they have order access.
Escalate with the order number if it still doesn't appear.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: request delivery date extension.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for orders & delivery: You can request a delivery extension from the order page; the buyer approves or rejects it.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to open the order and choose 'Request extension'.
Have them enter a new date and a clear reason.
Explain that late delivery penalties may apply if the buyer rejects the request.
Advise them to request the extension before the original date passes.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: order cancelled by buyer.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for orders & delivery: Buyers can cancel before dispatch. If you had already shipped, we can help you raise a claim.
resolution_steps: Check whether the order was cancelled before or after dispatch.
If before dispatch, explain no further action is needed.
If after dispatch, ask for the shipment tracking number.
Guide the caller to raise a cancellation claim with the tracking proof.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: invoice generation failed.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for invoices & payments: Invoices can only be generated after the buyer confirms receipt. Let's check the order status.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number.
Check whether the buyer has generated the goods receipt.
If not, explain that the invoice unlocks after receipt confirmation.
If receipt is confirmed, ask the caller to retry and note any error code.
Escalate with the error code if generation still fails.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: payment delayed after delivery.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for invoices & payments: Buyers have 10 days after receipt to pay. Let me check where the payment is in that cycle.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number and invoice date.
Check whether the buyer has confirmed receipt and approved the invoice.
If within 10 days of receipt, explain the payment timeline.
If overdue, raise a payment follow-up to the buyer organisation.
Escalate if the follow-up is unanswered after three business days.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: tax amount mismatch on invoice.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for invoices & payments: Tax is calculated from the product's tax category at order time. Let's compare that with your invoice.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number and the tax rate the caller expected.
Check the tax category saved on the listing at order time.
If the listing category was wrong, guide the caller to issue a credit note and corrected invoice.
Remind them to fix the listing so future orders are correct.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: courier missed the scheduled pickup.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for shipping & logistics: Missed pickups happen when the courier slot was full. We can rebook it and protect your dispatch date.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number and the pickup slot that was booked.
Check the courier's pickup status and any 'attempted' note.
Rebook the pickup for the next available slot from the shipment page.
If the dispatch deadline is today, mark the order 'pickup delayed by courier' so no penalty applies.
Escalate if the courier misses the rebooked slot.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: shipping label will not generate.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for shipping & logistics: Labels fail when the package weight or dimensions are missing. Let's check the shipment form.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to open the shipment form for the order.
Confirm package weight and all three dimensions are filled in.
Check that the pickup address has a valid postcode.
Ask them to regenerate the label and download the PDF.

entries.issue_name: Courier says delivery address is undeliverable
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: courier says delivery address is undeliverable.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for shipping & logistics: When the courier can't find the address, we confirm it with the buyer before the parcel is sent back.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number and the courier's failure reason.
Contact the buyer's consignee through the order messages to confirm the address and a phone number.
Share the corrected details with the courier from the shipment page.
If the buyer doesn't reply in 48 hours, let the shipment return and inform the buyer.

entries.issue_name: Add a sub-user to seller account
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: add a sub-user to seller account.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for sub-users & roles: Admins can add sub-users and give them limited roles, so your team can work without sharing passwords.
resolution_steps: Confirm the caller is the account admin.
Guide them to Settings > Users > Add user.
Have them choose a role such as Catalogue, Bids or Finance.
Explain that the new user receives an activation email.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: sub-user cannot access bids.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for sub-users & roles: When a sub-user can't see a section, it's almost always their role. The admin can adjust it.
resolution_steps: Ask which section the sub-user cannot open.
Ask the admin to open Settings > Users and check that user's role.
Add the Bids permission or change the role.
Ask the sub-user to sign out and back in.

entries.issue_name: Transfer admin role to another user
entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: transfer admin role to another user.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for sub-users & roles: Transferring admin rights protects your account when people change roles. It needs confirmation from the business.
resolution_steps: If the current admin is available, they can transfer the role from Settings > Users.
If the admin has left, collect an authorisation letter from the business.
The new admin must complete identity verification.
Escalate letter-based transfers for manual approval.
required_documents: Identity proof of the new admin

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: buyer raised a quality dispute.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for disputes & returns: When a buyer raises a quality dispute, you get seven days to respond with evidence.
resolution_steps: Ask for the dispute ID.
Explain the seven-day response window.
Guide the caller to respond with photos, test reports or replacement offers.
Explain that the dispute cell decides if both sides cannot agree.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: return pickup not scheduled.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for disputes & returns: Return pickups are scheduled by the seller within three days of the return being approved.
resolution_steps: Ask for the return ID.
Check whether the return was approved.
Guide the seller to schedule pickup from the return page.
If the courier missed the pickup, ask them to reschedule and share the courier reference.

entries.problem_statement: Seller reports: penalty applied incorrectly.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for disputes & returns: Penalties are applied automatically for late delivery. If the delay wasn't yours, you can request a waiver.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number and the penalty amount.
Check whether an extension was approved for the order.
If an approved extension exists, raise a waiver request with the approval reference.
If the buyer caused the delay, collect evidence and raise a waiver request.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: register a new buyer organisation.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for organisation onboarding: Organisations register once, then add their purchasing staff as users. I'll walk you through it.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller for the organisation's legal name and official email domain.
Guide them to 'Register as buyer' and complete the organisation form.
Explain that an approving officer must be nominated during registration.
Tell them approval takes up to two business days.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: approving officer not assigned.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for organisation onboarding: Purchases above the direct-buy limit need an approving officer. Let's assign one.
resolution_steps: Confirm the caller is the organisation admin.
Guide them to Organisation > Approval hierarchy.
Have them select an existing user as approving officer or invite a new one.
Explain that pending purchases resume once the officer accepts.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: organisation details are incorrect.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for organisation onboarding: Organisation details can be corrected by the admin, with a supporting letter for name changes.
resolution_steps: Ask which field is incorrect.
For address or contact changes, guide the admin to Organisation > Details.
For name changes, collect an official letter on letterhead.
Explain that name changes are reviewed within two business days.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: buyer otp not received.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for login & otp: Let's get your login code through. Delays usually come from SMS filtering or an outdated number.
resolution_steps: Confirm the last four digits of the registered mobile number.
Ask the caller to wait 60 seconds before pressing 'Resend OTP' once.
Offer the email OTP option if available.
If the number is outdated, start the mobile update process with the organisation admin.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: buyer account locked.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for login & otp: Accounts lock for 30 minutes after five failed attempts. I can help you reset safely.
resolution_steps: Tell the caller how long remains on the lock.
Recommend a password reset once the lock lifts.
If urgent, verify identity with the organisation admin and raise an unlock request.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: update registered mobile number.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for login & otp: Mobile numbers are updated by verifying both the email and the new number.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to open Profile > Contact details.
Have them verify the change with an email OTP.
Then verify the new number with an SMS OTP.
If they can't access the email, the organisation admin must approve the change.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: create a new buyer user.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for users & roles: Organisation admins can add buyers and assign purchase limits per user.
resolution_steps: Confirm the caller is the organisation admin.
Guide them to Organisation > Users > Add user.
Have them set the role and the per-order purchase limit.
Explain that the new user activates from the invitation email.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: deactivate a user who left.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for users & roles: Deactivating departed users keeps your organisation's purchases secure. Their open orders can be reassigned.
resolution_steps: Ask the admin to open Organisation > Users and select the user.
Choose 'Deactivate' and reassign their open orders to another buyer.
Explain that order history stays available for audits.
required_documents: Name of the user to deactivate

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: change buyer role or permissions.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for users & roles: Roles and purchase limits are set by the organisation admin and take effect on next login.
resolution_steps: Ask which permission or limit needs to change.
Guide the admin to Organisation > Users > Edit role.
Explain that limits above the organisation cap need approving officer sign-off.
Ask the user to sign out and back in.
required_documents: Approving officer sign-off for higher limits

entries.issue_name: Price changed after adding to cart
entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: price changed after adding to cart.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for direct purchase: Prices in the cart refresh from the seller's live listing. Let's check what changed.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to open the cart and read the 'price updated' notice.
Explain that sellers can change prices until checkout.
Suggest comparing with similar listings before confirming.
If the price changed after checkout, collect the order number and escalate.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: direct purchase limit exceeded.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for direct purchase: Direct purchases have a value cap. Above it, you'll need approval or a bid.
resolution_steps: Ask for the cart value and the caller's purchase limit.
If under the organisation cap, request approval from the approving officer.
If above the organisation cap, explain that a bid or RFQ is required.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: compare products before purchase.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for direct purchase: The comparison view shows up to four listings side by side, so you can choose the best value.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to tick 'Compare' on up to four listings.
Explain the columns: price, delivery time, seller rating and warranty.
Remind them to record the reason if they don't choose the lowest price.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: create a request for quotation.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for bids & rfqs: An RFQ invites sellers to quote for your requirement. I'll guide you through publishing one.
resolution_steps: Guide the caller to Sourcing > Create RFQ.
Have them enter specifications, quantity and delivery location.
Ask them to set a bid deadline at least seven days away.
Explain that the approving officer must approve before publishing.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: extend bid deadline.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for bids & rfqs: You can extend a bid deadline before it closes; sellers are notified automatically.
resolution_steps: Ask for the bid number.
Check that the deadline hasn't passed.
Guide the caller to Bid > Amend > Extend deadline.
Explain that a reason is recorded and visible to sellers.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: technical evaluation upload failed.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for bids & rfqs: Evaluation results must be uploaded in the provided template. Let's check the file.
resolution_steps: Ask for the bid number and the error message.
Confirm the file uses the latest evaluation template.
Check that every participating seller has a qualified or disqualified status with remarks.
Ask the caller to retry the upload.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: order status not updated.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for orders & delivery: Order status updates when the seller records dispatch. Let's check the latest event.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number.
Check the last status event and its timestamp.
If the seller hasn't marked dispatch, send a reminder to the seller.
If dispatched, share the tracking link with the caller.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: change consignee after ordering.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for orders & delivery: The consignee can be changed before dispatch, with the seller's agreement.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number and the new consignee details.
Check that the order hasn't been dispatched.
Guide the caller to Order > Request consignee change.
Explain that the seller must accept the change.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: delivery overdue.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for orders & delivery: If delivery is overdue, you can follow up with the seller and penalties apply automatically.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number and the promised delivery date.
Check whether the seller requested an extension.
If not, send a delivery follow-up to the seller.
Explain how late delivery penalties are calculated.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: generate goods receipt.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for receiving & inspection: Generating the goods receipt confirms delivery and starts the seller's payment cycle.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to open the order and choose 'Generate receipt'.
Have them enter quantity received and inspection result.
Explain that the receipt must be generated within 10 days of delivery.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: reject damaged goods.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for receiving & inspection: You can reject damaged items during receipt; the seller is asked to replace them.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to record the damage with photos.
During receipt, mark the affected quantity as rejected with a reason.
Explain that the seller has seven days to replace the items.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: partial delivery receipt.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for receiving & inspection: For partial deliveries, receipt the quantity you received; the rest stays open.
resolution_steps: Ask how many units were received against the order quantity.
Guide the caller to receipt only the received quantity.
Explain that the balance remains open for the seller to deliver.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: payment not processed after receipt.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for payments & invoices: After receipt, the invoice must be approved before payment releases. Let's find which step is pending.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number.
Check whether the invoice was approved by the finance user.
If not approved, guide the finance user to Payments > Pending invoices.
If approved, check the payment batch status and share the reference.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: invoice missing for order.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for payments & invoices: Sellers upload the invoice after your goods receipt. If it's missing, we can nudge the seller.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number.
Confirm the goods receipt was generated.
If yes, send an invoice reminder to the seller.
Explain that payment can't start until the invoice is uploaded.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: corporate card declined at checkout.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for payments & invoices: Card payments are declined by the issuing bank, not by us. Let's check the usual causes before trying again.
resolution_steps: Ask for the decline message shown at checkout.
Check whether the order total exceeds the card's per-transaction limit.
Ask the caller to confirm the card is enabled for online purchases.
Offer invoice-based payment if the organisation has it enabled.

entries.issue_name: Raise a dispute against a seller
entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: raise a dispute against a seller.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for disputes & feedback: You can raise a dispute from the order page; the seller gets seven days to respond.
resolution_steps: Ask for the order number and the nature of the issue.
Guide the caller to Order > Raise dispute.
Have them attach evidence such as photos or reports.
Explain the seven-day seller response window.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: rate a seller after delivery.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for disputes & feedback: Seller ratings help other buyers. You can rate after the goods receipt.
resolution_steps: Ask the caller to open the completed order.
Guide them to 'Rate seller' and score delivery, quality and communication.
Explain that ratings can be edited within 30 days.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: escalate an unresolved complaint.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for disputes & feedback: If your complaint hasn't been resolved in time, I can escalate it to the dispute cell.
resolution_steps: Ask for the dispute ID.
Check how long the dispute has been open.
If past the response window, escalate to the dispute cell.
Share the escalation reference with the caller.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: close a buyer account.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for account closure: Accounts can be closed once there are no open orders, bids or payments.
resolution_steps: Check for open orders, active bids and pending payments.
Ask the organisation admin to submit a closure request with a letter.
Explain that records are retained for audit after closure.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: transfer pending orders before closure.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for account closure: Before closing, open orders must be completed or moved to another active buyer.
resolution_steps: List the open orders with the caller.
Guide the admin to reassign each order to an active buyer.
Confirm no orders remain before submitting closure.

entries.problem_statement: Buyer reports: reactivate a closed account.
entries.policy: Northwind Marketplace support guideline for account closure: Closed accounts can be reactivated within 90 days with a request from the organisation.
resolution_steps: Check when the account was closed.
If within 90 days, collect a reactivation letter from the organisation.
If older than 90 days, explain that a fresh registration is required.
